record.original_question: Consider the Γ̄q structure γ on the manifold SO(q) whose microfoliation is the suspension of the canonical action of SO(q) on Rq . Is γ null-homotopic in B Γ̄q ?

evidence.quote: Question 9.2 (Hurder-Vogt [Hur93, Hur06, Lan94]). Consider the Γ̄q structure γ on the manifold SO(q) whose microfoliation is the suspension of the canonical action of SO(q) on Rq . Is γ null-homotopic in B Γ̄q ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q\geq 1$ be an integer and let $SO(q)$ denote the special orthogonal group, viewed as a smooth manifold of dimension $\binom{q}{2}$. Recall that a $\overline{\Gamma}_q$-structure on a manifold $M$ is a Haefliger structure of codimension $q$ together with a trivialization of its normal microbundle; such structures are classified up to concordance by homotopy classes of maps from $M$ into the classifying space $B\overline{\Gamma}_q$. Given a smooth action of a Lie group $G$ on $\mathbb{R}^q$ by diffeomorphisms fixing the origin, the suspension construction produces a codimension-$q$ Haefliger structure on $G$ whose microfoliation, after framing the normal bundle by the standard framing of $\mathbb{R}^q$ at the origin, defines a $\overline{\Gamma}_q$-structure on $G$.

Apply this to the canonical (defining) linear action of $SO(q)$ on $\mathbb{R}^q$, and let $\gamma$ denote the resulting $\overline{\Gamma}_q$-structure on the manifold $SO(q)$. Determine whether the classifying map of $\gamma$ is null-homotopic in $B\overline{\Gamma}_q$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a long-standing problem attributed to Hurder, Vogt, and Lang concerning the connectivity properties of the Haefliger classifying space $B\overline{\Gamma}_q$. Recent work on connectivity of Haefliger classifying spaces (e.g. Nariman's "On flat manifold bundles and the connectivity of Haefliger's classifying spaces", 2022) discusses related connectivity results but does not resolve this specific question, which remains open.

status_evidence.title: On flat manifold bundles and the connectivity of Haefliger's classifying spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses connectivity of BΓ̄q and related structures associated with Lie group actions
status_evidence.claim: Recent work addresses connectivity of B\bar Γ_q but does not resolve the specific Hurder–Vogt question about the SO(q)-suspension structure.

status_evidence.title: Classifying foliations - Steven Hurder
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of classifying foliations and BΓ_q including questions on suspensions of group actions
status_evidence.claim: Hurder's surveys list this as an outstanding question.
